---
description: "Research project issues using official documentation and reputable community sources; cite findings."
name: "research"
agent: "agent"
---
When encountering snags or problems, search online for answers using forums (Stack Overflow, Reddit, GitHub Issues) and official documentation. Check dependency manuals, library documentation, and existing software documentation. Compile findings and present solutions with clear attribution to sources. Prioritize official documentation, then community Q&A, then general discussions.
